name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light is an empirical civilian aerospace diagnostics and multi-sensor sky deconfliction platform modeled after the iconic automotive Check Engine Light with OBD-III diagnostic protocols. The platform is architected around 4 core operational modules: TARGET (optical AR tracking, device IMU gyro telemetry, and visual lock HUD), RADAR (real-time ADS-B flight transponders, NOAA weather balloons, NORAD LEO satellite orbits, and planetary ephemeris deconfliction), ANALYZE (forensic Dual-Lens evaluation contrasting Classical Aerospace against Theoretical Metric Manipulation, Multi-Lens consensus review, zero-tolerance safety guardrails, and synthetic CGI discrimination), and REPORT (cryptographic-grade field dossiers, multi-sensor timeline reconstruction, and exportable incident documentation). Check Sky Light systematically eliminates conventional air traffic, celestial mirages, sensor artifacts, and digital hoaxes before evaluating authentic anomalous signatures.
